title: Four structural formulas show aldehydes and ketones, with each carbonyl group (C=O) highlighted in pink
details: diagram: Four structural formulas show aldehydes and ketones, with each carbonyl group (C=O) highlighted in pink. Students should notice that an aldehyde's C=O sits at the end of a carbon chain as -CHO, while a ketone's C=O sits inside the chain, flanked by carbon on both sides.
